bootstrap.joint_resample_semantics: One multinomial count vector over trajectory indices 0..999 is drawn per bootstrap replicate and applied unchanged to all 12 eligible physical cells. This is exactly equivalent to drawing 1000 trajectory indices iid with replacement and preserves CRN-index dependence across cells.
